ModMetaData.name: Vanilla UI+ Alerts
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Part of Vanilla UI+: small UI improvements that stay close to the vanilla look.
Keeps the right-side colony alerts in equal-width bars. Labels stay on one line with an ellipsis by default. Right-click an alert to snooze it for a set number of days (default 3).
